statements.statement: The policy pays up to $1,000 for broken glass.
statements.quote: We cover repair or replacement of the windscreen, side windows, rear window and sunroof of the vehicle, including recalibration of cameras and sensors mounted on the windscreen, up to a limit of $1,000 per claim.

statements.statement: The policy has a $50 excess for glass claims.
statements.quote: You pay the following excess on each claim: collision claims $300; glass claims $50; theft claims $450.
